EVIDENCE LOOP — PROPOSED, NOT YET BUILT · SUG-241
Deliberately shallow, not underbuilt — Sugartown has one VoPM. Bex is the requirements source, stakeholder, and
sign-off in the same person. A structural fact, not a gap. Audience Check stays pink for a different reason: the
actual readers — recruiters, hiring managers — are genuinely external. No amount of solo rigor substitutes for them.
